description: B2B email finding and contact enrichment from Dropcontact - submit contacts for enrichment, read qualified email results, check remaining credits, and manage the account default webhook callback URL.

api.description: Read the enrichment credits left on the account; costs no credits

fields.description: Enrichment credits left on the account.

api.description: Submit up to 250 contacts for email finding, verification and company enrichment; spends one credit per contact and returns a request_id, not the results

fields.description: Up to 250 contacts. Enrichment runs as a batch, so the call returns a request_id rather than results.
Ask for French SIREN company data. Defaults to false.
Language for the qualifications and civility in the result, such as "en" or "fr". Defaults to "fr".
Where to POST the results once the batch finishes. Overrides the account default for this request only.
Ask for the hashed inputs in the response. Sent as the `hashedInputs` query parameter.
Pass this to `enrichment.results` to read the batch.

fields.description: The `data` array: per-record notes keyed by index. An entry here does not mean the submission failed.

api.description: Read the enriched contacts for a request_id: qualified emails, LinkedIn, phone and company data; reports success false with a reason while the batch is still processing

fields.description: Return whatever has already been enriched instead of asking you to retry. Adds a `status` per record (`ready` or `in_progress`).

fields.description: One entry per submitted record, in the order they were sent. Empty while a batch has not produced anything yet.
`ready` once the batch has finished, `in_progress` while Dropcontact is still processing. Dropcontact sets this field only when `force_results` is passed, so it is derived from `success` otherwise.

Whether this read returned usable records. It is not a completion flag: a forced partial read is successful with `status: in_progress`. A false value is a normal poll result while a batch runs, so the call returns rather than throwing.
Present when `success` is false, such as "Request not ready yet".

api.description: Read the default webhook callback URL used by enrichment requests that carry no custom callback of their own

fields.description: The account default, or null when none is set.

api.description: Delete the account default webhook callback URL; afterwards only requests carrying their own custom_callback_url notify anything
Set the account default webhook callback URL, replacing any previous one; enrichment requests without their own callback POST their results there

fields.description: Where to POST results for every request that does not carry its own `custom_callback_url`.
